findings.finding: An instrumented run adds five negative-J tetrahedra in lower collar part8 during Relocate3D; identical corner-node order and changed coordinates establish motion across inversion. Fixed seed1 and single thread repeated twice with matching per-stage hashes; both inputs end with positive native and Gmsh API Jacobians and exact straight midside coordinates. No full topology/closure/FE checks were run on these diagnostic candidates.

findings.confidence: confirmed localization; proposed cause is scale/topology mismatch
findings.finding: 0002 low-SICN cells are entirely in adhesive and polar collars; 0018 concentrates 4198/4339 in polar collars. Collar root geometry includes nominal +0.03mm start and piecewise conical outer surfaces against a spline inner interface.

findings.confidence: confirmed geometric discrepancy; total correction attribution not certified
findings.finding: Sampled boundary corner nodes lie on their same CAD faces to about 1e-7mm, while planar facet centers in collars can deviate by several hundredths of a millimeter. Native tetra volume and independent boundary-flux volume agree at roundoff. Thus measured CAD/mesh volume difference is not a simple summation or part-ID bookkeeping artifact; straight-facet representation is a contributor. Sampled first-order correction is too approximate to apportion the entire volume error.
